entries.subject: Radius adopted from the published record
entries.finding: Radius: Radius 78.9 ± 7.4 solar radii from Moravveji et al. (2012), ApJ 747, 108, who combine the limb-darkened angular diameter 2.75 ± 0.01 mas of Aufdenberg et al. (2008) with the Hipparcos distance. Adopted 54,890,730 km, 78.9000 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius. No gravitational parameter is adopted. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is adopted. Placement: SIMBAD basic record for * bet Ori (HIP 24436), ICRS J2000 position, reference 2007A&A...474..653V, retrieved 2026-09-21: https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=bet+Ori; Inverse of the Hipparcos new-reduction parallax 3.78 ± 0.34 mas (van Leeuwen 2007) via SIMBAD.
